title: The Best Matter Robot Vacuums
subtitle: Robot vacuums that work with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant, ranked.
intro: We pulled the robot vacuums on Amazon whose listings name Matter support and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: mopping, self-emptying bases, LiDAR navigation, and suction.
systems_note: Only listings that name Matter are included. Other robot vacuums say they work with Siri, which means Siri Shortcuts, not Matter.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: SwitchBot's K11+ joins Matter directly, empties itself for 90 days, and is the most-reviewed Matter vacuum.

awards.label: Most Powerful
awards.why: Double the K11+'s suction at 12,000 Pa in the same compact body.

awards.label: Best Mopping
awards.why: A self-washing roller mop with hot-air drying.

products.verdict: A small, slim robot that shows up natively in Apple Home, Google, and Alexa.

buyers_guide.q: What does Matter add to a robot vacuum?
buyers_guide.a: You can start, stop, and send it home from Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, or Home Assistant, and use it in automations across systems. Mapping and room selection still live in the maker's app.

buyers_guide.q: Do Matter vacuums need a hub?
buyers_guide.a: Wi-Fi Matter vacuums need a Matter controller such as an Apple TV, HomePod, Nest Hub, or Echo.
Yes, if you don't want to empty the bin every run. A base holds weeks of dust in a bag.
